html:
Gungunhana was the last king of the Gaza Empire, the Nguni state that ruled much of southern Mozambique, from 1884 until he was captured by the Portuguese in 1895.

The Gaza kingdom had been founded by Nguni fleeing the wars of the Mfecane, and his grandfather Soshangane conquered the Tsonga and others. Gungunhana tried to play Portugal against Britain and Cecil Rhodes, who wanted his land for the route to the coast.

In 1895 a Portuguese army defeated his regiments, and the officer Mouzinho de Albuquerque seized him at Chaimite. He was paraded in Lisbon and exiled to the Azores, where he died. His fall gave Portugal control of the south, where Lourenço Marques became the capital, and he is a national hero in Mozambique.
sum: Gungunhana was the last king of the Gaza Empire, the Nguni state that ruled much of southern Mozambique, from 1884 until he was captured by the Portuguese in 1895.
